statusNote.en: The SPVM briefly deployed a fixed ALPR camera in Montreal, then withdrew it under public scrutiny — but the contract and stated intent remain. In early August 2026 a Genetec Cloudrunner CR-H2 stationary plate-reader — the first fixed ALPR on a public road in the city — was found on a lamppost on Boulevard Henri-Bourassa in Rivière-des-Prairies (Radio-Canada, 2026-08-12). The same day, after the report, the SPVM confirmed the camera was its own and removed it, saying it had been installed temporarily to 'support targeted investigation work' and was pulled 'to preserve ongoing investigation strategies.' It ran under an October 2025 rental contract for four Genetec Cloudrunner units ($17,134, dossier 1742638) — a below-threshold purchase with no public tender or council process; the SPVM said further cameras 'could be added' as investigations require, and access to captured images is 'reserved exclusively' to investigators. The City administration and the Agence de mobilité durable said they had not been informed of the deployment. Separately, the SPVM has operated a mobile ALPR system (SRPI) on roughly 30 patrol vehicles for over a decade.
statusNote.fr: Le SPVM a brièvement déployé une caméra ALPR fixe à Montréal, puis l'a retirée sous la pression publique — mais le contrat et l'intention déclarée demeurent. Au début d'août 2026, une caméra fixe de lecture de plaques Genetec Cloudrunner CR-H2 — la première caméra ALPR fixe sur la voie publique dans la métropole — a été repérée sur un lampadaire du boulevard Henri-Bourassa, dans Rivière-des-Prairies (Radio-Canada, 2026-08-12). Le jour même, après le reportage, le SPVM a confirmé que la caméra était la sienne et l'a retirée, indiquant qu'elle avait été installée temporairement pour « soutenir le travail d'enquête ciblé » et retirée « afin de préserver les stratégies d'enquête en cours ». Elle fonctionnait dans le cadre d'un contrat de location d'octobre 2025 pour quatre unités Genetec Cloudrunner (17 134 $, dossier 1742638) — un achat sous les seuils d'appel d'offres, sans processus public; le SPVM a indiqué que d'autres caméras « pourraient être ajoutées » selon les besoins des enquêtes, et que l'accès aux images captées est « réservé exclusivement » aux enquêteurs. L'administration de la Ville et l'Agence de mobilité durable affirment ne pas avoir été informées du déploiement. Par ailleurs, le SPVM exploite un système ALPR mobile (SRPI) sur une trentaine de véhicules de patrouille depuis plus d'une décennie.

summary.en: Jason King, a candidate for Ward 14 Councillor in London's October 2026 election, opposes fixed ALPR cameras. Responding to panopti.ca's questionnaire, King — who describes himself as an intelligence and surveillance specialist — said he would vote against any ALPR procurement or expansion regardless of cost, arguing the cameras and their AI data-collection infringe basic protections against state overreach. His answers appear below in his own words.
summary.fr: Jason King, candidat au poste de conseiller municipal du quartier 14 à l'élection d'octobre 2026 à London, s'oppose aux caméras ALPR fixes. En réponse au questionnaire de panopti.ca, M. King — qui se décrit comme un spécialiste du renseignement et de la surveillance — a affirmé qu'il voterait contre toute acquisition ou expansion des ALPR, peu importe le coût, estimant que ces caméras et la collecte de données par IA qu'elles permettent portent atteinte aux protections fondamentales contre les abus de l'État. Ses réponses, dans ses propres mots, apparaissent ci-dessous. (Réponses fournies en anglais.)

title.en: Q1 — Support or oppose fixed ALPRs
title.fr: Q1 — Pour ou contre les ALPR fixes

note.en: I don't support fixed ALPR cameras for the City of London. As an intelligence and surveillance specialist myself, I understand the invasiveness and risks of security of the person these bring to a free society. I believe in strict limitations on government intrusion into the lives of citizens and that the freedom to move freely MUST be inclusive of government's inability to track and capture your movement as well. The AI tools and data collection that these cameras interface with infringe our very basic rights and protections from state overreach.

title.en: Q2 — How would you vote on procurement?
title.fr: Q2 — Comment voteriez-vous sur l'acquisition?

note.en: I would vote against any procurement or usage of these devices in the City of London regardless of if it costs Londoners through municipal tax dollars or any other level of taxation.
note.fr: I would vote against any procurement or usage of these devices in the City of London regardless of if it costs Londoners through municipal tax dollars or any other level of taxation.

title.en: Q3 — Limits on ALPR data
title.fr: Q3 — Limites sur les données ALPR

note.en: Should ALPR cameras be approved in London despite my opposition, I would insist that any access or use of the data collected was subject to judicial warrant just as any other search and seizure proceedings would be by the police. These cameras are also subject to PIPEDA and must adhere to the strict rules governing when collection of electronic data of someone is collected or used.

office.fr: Candidat au poste de conseiller municipal, quartier 7

summary.en: Sam Hajar, a candidate for Ward 7 Councillor in London's October 2026 election, supports fixed ALPR cameras — conditionally. In his response to panopti.ca's questionnaire, Hajar said he would "most likely vote yes for a pilot program," but only alongside strong privacy safeguards: oversight across all three levels of government, data-sharing limited to warrant- or court-ordered active investigations, a 90-day retention cap on non-investigative data, mandatory public consultation, and published privacy impact assessments before any rollout. His answers appear below in his own words.
summary.fr: Sam Hajar, candidat au poste de conseiller municipal du quartier 7 à l'élection d'octobre 2026 à London, appuie les caméras ALPR fixes — sous conditions. Dans sa réponse au questionnaire de panopti.ca, M. Hajar a indiqué qu'il voterait « fort probablement oui pour un programme pilote », mais seulement avec de solides mesures de protection de la vie privée : une surveillance aux trois ordres de gouvernement, un partage des données limité aux enquêtes actives visées par un mandat ou une ordonnance judiciaire, une conservation maximale de 90 jours pour les données non liées à une enquête, une consultation publique obligatoire et des évaluations des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée rendues publiques avant tout déploiement. Ses réponses, dans ses propres mots, apparaissent ci-dessous. (Réponses fournies en anglais.)

note.en: I support the use and deployment of fixed Automated Licence Plate Recognition (ALPR) cameras, but must be accompanied with strong privacy safeguards, oversight on all tiers of government (municipal, provincial and federal), and strict limits on how the information collected can be used. This technology if used correctly may make our community safer.

title.en: Q3 — Limits on ALPR data
title.fr: Q3 — Limites sur les données ALPR

note.en: I would require clear limits on ALPR data with privacy protections. If the data is not part of an active investigation I would request the data be retained only for a minimum of 90 days. If there is an active investigation I would require the data be retained until the investigation has gone through the court process and the investigation has been closed and no appeals have been filed.
note.fr: I would require clear limits on ALPR data with privacy protections. If the data is not part of an active investigation I would request the data be retained only for a minimum of 90 days. If there is an active investigation I would require the data be retained until the investigation has gone through the court process and the investigation has been closed and no appeals have been filed.

title.en: Q4 — Data-sharing with other agencies
title.fr: Q4 — Partage des données avec d'autres organismes

note.en: I would permit ALPR data collected in the municipality to be shared with other police services or federal agencies only when there is a clear and legitimate and connected an active investigation, such as court order, warrant, rather than allowing unrestricted access to the database.
note.fr: I would permit ALPR data collected in the municipality to be shared with other police services or federal agencies only when there is a clear and legitimate and connected an active investigation, such as court order, warrant, rather than allowing unrestricted access to the database.

title.en: Q5 — Public consultation & privacy assessment
title.fr: Q5 — Consultation publique et évaluation vie privée

note.en: Public consultation must happen before the City commits to the technology. Yes, I would commit to making Privacy Impact Assessments public for significant surveillance technologies before implementation.
note.fr: Public consultation must happen before the City commits to the technology. Yes, I would commit to making Privacy Impact Assessments public for significant surveillance technologies before implementation.

title.en: Q6 — Where the money should go
title.fr: Q6 — Réaffectation des fonds

note.en: First I would approach the provincial and federal government for funding and fund the project either through the police budget and or the tax roll.
note.fr: First I would approach the provincial and federal government for funding and fund the project either through the police budget and or the tax roll.

title.en: Q7 — FOI responsiveness
title.fr: Q7 — Réponse aux demandes d'accès à l'information

note.en: Yes. I would commit to providing timely, complete, and transparent responses to freedom-of-information requests concerning surveillance technology, and respecting any legitimate privacy, security, or legal exemptions and concerns.
note.fr: Yes. I would commit to providing timely, complete, and transparent responses to freedom-of-information requests concerning surveillance technology, and respecting any legitimate privacy, security, or legal exemptions and concerns.

title.en: Q8 — Message to voters
title.fr: Q8 — Message aux électeurs

note.en: Public safety is important. Exploring this technology may make the community a safer place.
note.fr: Public safety is important. Exploring this technology may make the community a safer place.
